# Paply

> Paply is e-invoicing and fiscalization software for businesses in Slovenia and Croatia, made by ENZOR d.o.o. (Slovenia). Businesses create, send, receive, fiscalize and archive invoices in one web app (paply.app), with a mobile app for Android and iOS coming soon. Paply is in its testing phase and opening up step by step; exchange of structured e-invoices over the e-invoice network is coming soon, and until then invoices are sent by email with a PDF.

Key facts:

- Countries: Slovenia and Croatia today; Serbia on the roadmap. Interface in English, Slovenian, Croatian and Serbian.
- Fiscalization: Slovenia via FURS (ZOI/EOR codes, business premises and devices, verification QR code, automatic resubmission); Croatia F1 fiscalization via the Tax Administration (ZKI/JIR, verification QR code).
- E-invoice formats (exchange coming soon): eSLOG 2.0 (Slovenia), UBL 2.1 (Croatia), both EN 16931.
- Plans (per month, excl. VAT): Free €0 (1 team member; unlimited drafts, templates, PDF, approvals; no fiscalization, no network exchange) · Start €12 (2 team members + 5 read-only users, 50 exchanged e-invoices/month, fiscalization, email delivery, payment reminders, archive, document management, cash register) · Core €27 (5 + 20, 150/month, AI invoice scanning, Stripe/Shopify/Odoo connectors, email inbox connector, sending from your own mailbox, REST API, priority support) · Pro €59 (15 + 50, 400/month, higher daily AI scanning limit, higher support priority) · Enterprise custom (1,000+, unlimited users, ERP integrations, SLA, dedicated support). €0.15 per extra exchanged e-invoice on every paid plan. Invoice creation is unlimited on every plan.
- Yearly billing: 2 months free (Start €120, Core €270, Pro €590 a year). The e-invoice allowance stays monthly. Upgrades apply immediately (you pay the difference); downgrades take effect at the end of the paid period.
- Other features: estimates and customer orders, purchase orders, cash register for counter sales in Slovenia and Croatia (Start and up), item barcodes and labels, sending received bills to payment, eSLOG/UBL XML import, bank reconciliation (CAMT.053, MT940), SEPA pain.001 payment files, UPN QR and HUB3 payment codes, approval workflows, recurring invoices, credit notes, advance invoices, price lists, multi-currency, represented companies (€4.90/month each), two-factor login, data hosted in the EU (Frankfurt).
- Coming soon: AI assistants. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or another Model Context Protocol (MCP) assistant to one Paply company, read only or with permission to prepare drafts that a person confirms in Paply. It can never send, issue or fiscalize invoices, make payments, change bank details, delete anything or change settings. Core, Pro and Enterprise plans.
- Retention: invoices are archived for 10 years (Slovenia) and 11 years (Croatia).
- Sign up: https://paply.app/register · Contact: info@enzor.si
